get.description: Returns the port advisories (LAN exposure, privileged/common port, …) for a port.
get.summary: Port advisories for a listen binding

get.description: Returns recent activity events, newest first.

204.description: Activity log cleared. No response body.

get.description: Returns the current status of every forward rule.
Returns every forward rule with its port advisories.

post.description: Creates a forward rule. A created rule with autostart enabled starts its forwarder.

201.description: The created rule with its port advisories.

409.description: A rule already listens on that binding.

post.description: Reorders the rules to the given id order; any rule id not listed keeps its relative order at the end (a partial set is allowed, a duplicate id is tolerated, an empty list is a no-op). An unknown id returns 404 and no reorder is persisted. Returns 200 with the full reordered rule list (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201). Reorder is metadata only — running forwarders are not affected.

400.description: `ids` is not an array of strings.

404.description: An id in the list does not match any rule.

patch.description: Partially updates a rule. Unspecified fields are left unchanged. A change to a forwarding field (protocol/listenHost/listenPort/targetHost/targetPort/udpMode) restarts the forwarder only if the rule is running; metadata-only changes (name/group/autostart) do not restart, and a stopped rule is not started.

200.description: The updated rule with its port advisories.

409.description: The update would duplicate another rule's binding.

delete.description: Deletes a rule. A running rule's forwarder is stopped first; an unknown id returns 404. Returns 204 with no body. The `:id` path param has no validation — an unknown id surfaces as the manager's NotFoundError → 404.

post.description: Starts the rule's forwarder and returns its current status. Idempotent — an already-running rule returns its status without restarting; autostart/enabled is not a precondition. An unknown id returns 404. Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

Stops the rule's forwarder and returns its current status. Idempotent — a rule that is not running returns its status without touching a socket. An unknown id returns 404. Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

Runs read-only diagnostics for the rule — listen-host/LAN-exposure/privileged-port/common-port advisories, a listen-bind probe (skipped while the rule is running, since Portier already owns the port), target-host DNS resolution, a TCP target-connect probe (skipped for UDP / unresolved targets), and the UDP mode (UDP only) — and returns the ordered checks plus an overall summary. Does not mutate the rule. An unknown id returns 404. Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

200.description: The diagnostic checks and summary for the rule.

post.description: Stops every rule sharing the given group label, in rule order. Behaviour over existing rule metadata — never mutates rule definitions, order, autostart, or group. A rule that is not running is skipped (not_running, no socket touched); the response summarizes per-rule results. An empty/invalid group name returns 400; a group with no matching rules returns 404. Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

200.description: Per-rule results + counts for the group stop.

400.description: The group name is empty or invalid.

404.description: No rules belong to that group.

post.summary: Stop a group of forward rules

post.description: Starts every rule sharing the given group label, in rule order. Behaviour over existing rule metadata — never mutates rule definitions, order, autostart, or group; autostart/enabled is not a precondition. A rule that is already running is skipped (already_running, no new socket); the response summarizes per-rule results. An empty/invalid group name returns 400; a group with no matching rules returns 404. Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

200.description: Per-rule results + counts for the group start.

400.description: The group name is empty or invalid.

404.description: No rules belong to that group.

post.summary: Start a group of forward rules

get.description: Returns the current forward rules as an exportable config.

post.description: Diffs the desired config against the current rules and returns the plan (operations, summary, errors, warnings) without mutating anything. A missing `desired` key returns 400; invalid desired rules surface as plan errors (still 200). Returns 200 (NestJS would otherwise default POST to 201).

Imports a Portier config in `replace` (replace all rules) or `merge` (add non-conflicting rules) mode. Returns 200 with the import result + the full rule list on success, or 422 with the errors + result when the import reports validation/duplicate-binding/merge-conflict errors (rejected before any mutation). An invalid mode or config returns 400. Unlike `plan` (a dry-run), import MUTATES the rules; enabled imported rules start their forwarders.

200.description: Import succeeded; the full rule list is returned.

post.description: Diffs the desired config against the current rules and applies it. A missing `desired` key returns 400; a plan with errors returns 200 `ok:false` (no mutation). `dryRun:true` returns the plan + applied counts without mutating (and is allowed even for destructive plans). A non-dry-run plan with destructive operations requires `yes:true` (else 400). When the plan has drift, the rules are replaced (MUTATING; enabled rules start). Unlike `plan` (always a dry-run) and `import` (a raw replace/merge), apply gates on drift/destructive/confirmation and returns the plan with an `appliedAt` timestamp.

200.description: The apply result (ok:true applied / ok:true dry-run / ok:false on plan errors), with the plan.

400.description: `desired` is required, or destructive operations require `yes:true`.

get.description: Returns live TCP connections, UDP sessions, and per-rule summaries.

info.title: Portier API
info.description: Portier management API — generated from the NestJS controllers and DTOs that serve the `/api` surface.

errors.description: One or more human-readable error messages.
example: port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.

desired.description: The desired config (object with a rules array). Required.

yes.description: Confirm destructive operations. Required (true) when the plan is destructive.

dryRun.description: Preview only — return the plan + applied counts without mutating.

ok.description: Whether the apply succeeded (false when the plan has errors).

dryRun.description: Whether this was a dry-run (no mutation).

plan.description: The plan that was applied (or would be).

mode.description: Import mode: replace all rules, or merge non-conflicting rules.

config.description: The Portier config to import (version 1 + a rules array).

result.description: The import outcome (zero imported on error).

rules.description: The full rule list after import (with advisories).

desired.description: The desired config (object with a rules array). Required.

before.description: Value before the change (a JSON scalar).

after.description: Value after the change (a JSON scalar).

destructive.description: Whether the operation restarts/removes a forwarder.

id.description: Rule id (absent for an added rule).

hasDrift.description: Whether the desired config differs from current.

hasErrors.description: Whether the plan has validation errors.

id.description: Optional client-supplied id (server generates a UUID when omitted).

enabled.description: Whether the rule autostarts (a created enabled rule starts its forwarder).

advisories.description: Port advisories for the rule's listen binding.

ruleId.description: Id of the rule this status describes.

group.description: The group label the action targeted.

skipped.description: Rules skipped (already in the target state).

reason.description: Skip token (already_running / not_running) or, for failed, the error message.

ids.description: Rule ids in the desired order. Ids not listed keep their relative order at the end.

lastTrafficAt.description: Most recent traffic time, or null.

recovery.description: Config-recovery state (v1.17); { active: false } in normal operation.

active.description: Whether the runtime is in config recovery mode.

reason.description: Why recovery is active (omitted when inactive).

configPath.description: Config path Portier tried to load.

quarantinePath.description: Where the bad config was quarantined (empty when none).

writesBlocked.description: Whether rule writes are blocked while recovery is active.

detectedAt.description: When the recovery condition was detected.

protocol.description: Forwarding protocol (forwarding field — changing it restarts a running rule).

enabled.description: Autostart flag (metadata — does not restart a running rule).

group.description: Grouping label (metadata; empty/whitespace clears, null/absent leaves unchanged).
